fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (31.1052,-87.0722) sat near the Brewton town center, ~1 km west of the mill (APPROXIMATE, 19 m flagged but actually mislocated to downtown). Mill core relocated via satellite to ~31.1068,-87.0658.
fieldNotes.facility: Integrated white-top linerboard and solid-bleached-sulfate (SBS) paperboard mill. Former Smurfit-Stone mill, acquired by GP in 2007; ~400+ employees; underwent the $400M 'Project Phoenix' modernization; first U.S. integrated paper mill to earn EPA ENERGY STAR (2021).
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE - confirmed. Street View (2023-05) shows a controlled mill entrance with a clear stop sign and checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: TRUE - confirmed. Street View clearly shows a small staffed guard booth (single-vehicle footprint, windows on multiple sides, door, posted signs) beside the entrance lane at ~31.1043,-87.0681.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Paved/gravel apron and yard space outside the gate booth where trucks can wait.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Receiving (woodyard, chip/log piles, chemical receiving) is physically separate from finished paperboard shipping at the warehouse dock banks - distinct clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long shipping warehouses show banks of dock doors with multiple trailers backed in; counted band 10-25 (likely toward the upper end), medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Paved yard near the warehouses holds parked trailers; band 10-25, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: pulp/paper processing core, woodyard with chip/log storage, multiple shipping/storage warehouses, paper-roll outdoor storage yards, plus support buildings - 16+ distinct structures.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple rail spurs run directly into the mill warehouses; rail cars visible at the buildings.
fieldNotes.scale: A truck scale is operationally expected for chip/log van weigh-in at an integrated paper mill; not pinpointed in imagery - flagged low-confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Brewton is a small Alabama town; the mill sits on the edge of town with forest on the north/east. Rural.

citations.claim: GP completes ~$1B transformation of Brewton containerboard/bleached-board mill; 400+ employees

verification.rationale: GP-owned with heavy 2025 capex; named as a mill absorbing Cedar Springs volume.
